source.description: Vanilla Pokémon Ultra Moon wild encounters.
source.primary: Datamined Pokémon Ultra Moon encounter tables
source.method: The encounter-table dump supplies direct species, forms, levels, rates, and day/night splits. PokeAPI version 30 records map tables to named areas and methods and supplies SOS, Island Scan, berry-pile, and postgame records.

documentNotes: Only Pokémon Ultra Moon records (version ID 30) are included.
Walking encounters count toward location completion; Surfing, fishing, bubbling spots, berry piles, Island Scan, SOS allies, and postgame Ultra Beasts are Return later.
SOS rows list available allies. The source does not identify one caller for every normalized SOS record.
Prismatic Moon numbered maps are intentionally omitted in Pokémon Ultra Moon mode.
